findings.summary: Migration failure no longer increments the `failed` counter.
findings.mechanism: The `*)` fallback case in the migrate-loop `case "$status" in` block previously incremented `failed` (visible in the removed lines), but the rewritten version only echoes the error and drops `failed=$((failed + 1))`. Any repo whose migrate call returns a non-200/409 status (auth error, 500, timeout, empty status) is silently excluded from the final `created=... skipped=... failed=...` summary, understating real failures.

findings.summary: gh_api has no `--max-time`, so the stated per-request time bound doesn't cover GitHub calls.
findings.mechanism: gitea_api was given --max-time 1800/60 to bound request duration per the task brief, but gh_api's curl invocation (used in the paginated enumeration loop) has no timeout at all, so a stalled connection to api.github.com can hang the script indefinitely despite the change's stated goal of bounding every single request.
